fever: Rest and drink fluids regularly. Seek care if fever becomes high, lasts more than 3 days, or symptoms worsen.
cough: Stay hydrated and avoid irritants (smoke/dust). Seek care if breathing becomes difficult or chest pain appears.
sore_throat: Warm fluids may help comfort. Seek care if severe difficulty swallowing or breathing symptoms appear.
diarrhea: Focus on hydration. Seek care if signs of dehydration, blood in stool, or severe abdominal pain appear.
vomiting: Take small sips of fluids. Seek care if persistent vomiting or signs of dehydration appear.
headache: Rest and hydrate. Seek care if severe/worst headache, confusion, weakness, or persistent vomiting occurs.
abdominal_pain: Eat light meals and hydrate. Seek care if pain becomes severe, persistent, or fever develops.
back_pain: Avoid heavy lifting and keep gentle movement as tolerated. Seek care if numbness, weakness, or bladder issues occur.
